caption: The drawing features a textile pattern with a central motif of a large red, stylized flower at the base, surrounded by an arrangement of smaller red and pink flowers and various green and yellow leaves on a light beige or tan background. The floral elements branch outwards in an organic, curving fashion, with the stems and leaves rendered in shades of green, olive, and yellow, accented by fine black detailing. Around the main floral arrangement is a decorative border on two sides, embellished with repeating patterns of red and yellow flowers, green leaves, and brown vines. The border is edged with small dots and fine lines, and the overall composition uses a warm palette dominated by reds, greens, yellows, and earth tones on a light, neutral backdrop. The textile effect is accentuated by the grid-like texture visible throughout the image.
title: Printed Scarf
